execution.description: Tried to create and clone into a mktemp directory through an inline PowerShell-to-WSL Bash command.

expected: Bash retains its temporary-directory variable and clones the ticket branch below /tmp.
observed: PowerShell expanded the Bash variable before WSL received the command, reducing the target to /repo; the clone failed with permission denied and created no checkout.
keep: Use a unique mktemp directory and clone only the exact local branch.
change: Pass a short checked-in-worktree Bash helper by path so PowerShell never interprets Bash variables.
